chapter.verse: Khanghampa in kong it taktak, kei bek hilo, thumaan thutak a thei khempeuh in zong a hong it, teeltuam tonu leh a tanote kong hopih hi.
Eite' sunga a omkip, a tawntungin zong eite tawh hong omkip ding ahi thumaan thutak hangin hong it ka hi uh hi.
Pa Pasian' kiangpan leh Pa' Tapa Jesu Khris' kiangpan thumaan thutak leh itna tawh kipawl hehpihna, thukhualna, leh nopna lemna, eite tawh hong omkhawm ding hi.
Pa in eite hong thupiak bang lianin na tanote kimkhat thumaan thutak tawh a nuntak uh ka muhkhiat manin nakpi-in ka lungdam hi.
Tu-in kong it tonu aw, thupiakna a thak khat hong gelh bang hilo-in a kipatcil panin i neihsa ahih mah bangin eite khatlekhat ki-it ni ci-in kong thum hi.
Ama' thupiaknate bangin i kalsuan pen itna hi a, hih pen na zuih dingin a kipatcil pan na zaksa thu ahi hi.
A hang pen mikhemte, Jesu Khris cilesa mihing suakin hong pai cih thu a sang lote, tampitak leitung ah kuankhia khin uh hi. Tua dan mi khatpeuh pen mikhem hi a, Khris-langneihmi ahi uh hi.
I sepsa nate mansuah lo-in pahtakman a dimin na ngah nadingun noleno kidawm un.
Khris' hilhcian thu sungah omkip lo-in a uang paite in Pasian nei lo uh hi. Hilhcian thu sungah a omkip khempeuh in Pa leh Tapa a nihin nei uh hi.
Note' kiangah mi khatpeuh hong pai henla hih hilhcian thu hong ken keileh na inn uhah tungsak kei unla, zong hopih vet kei un.
A hang pen amah a hopih peuhpeuh ama' thusia nasepna ah a kihel ahi hi.
No' tungah gelh ding tampi ka neih hangin laidal leh laitui ka zang nuam kei hi. Tua sangin i lungdamna a kicin nadingin note' kiangah hong pai-in maitang kituahin kiho ding ka lamen hi.
Teeltuam na sanggamnu' tate in note hong hopih hi.
